findings: `learner.overview.text` presents 巳 as “a sound element” without clarifying that this is the transmitted analysis. The expert account says the historical sound relationship is not established, while the displayed Mandarin pair sì–qǐ does not explain it. Qualify the overview as the transmitted analysis and briefly flag the proposed sound link as uncertain, citing E3, X-f5f5c16fc87db9cbcb47, and X-35c3d49dc56d4fc13621.

`learner.components[1].text` should say explicitly that 己 serves as the phonetic element in reported Chu forms and that those forms’ relationship to the transmitted 走-plus-巳 analysis is unsettled. The current wording “in this role” leaves the role ambiguous. Cite X-35c3d49dc56d4fc13621 and X-64e7d2aba6d24ed0bd1f.
